highlights.title: Tasks that repeat
highlights.line: Set a task to repeat every hour, day or week from its own page; its agent is reminded each time it is due.

highlights.title: Token Usage opens in seconds
highlights.line: Token Usage no longer re-reads your whole history each time, so on a long history it opens in seconds, not minutes.

highlights.title: Org charts with a ChatGPT subscription
highlights.line: When you build your team, Kosmos can now read a picture of your org chart using your ChatGPT subscription.

highlights.title: A cap for Gemini subscription agents
highlights.line: Settings > Automation can now cap how many Gemini subscription agents Kosmos sends work to at once.
